description: On a sandy shore under palm trees, a group of dark-skinned people, several bare-chested and wearing chains at the neck and wrists, sit or stand in the shade. In the centre, a tall man in a dark robe and black head wrap points toward a boat, beside a second man in a cream robe and beige turban. Two large lateen-sailed wooden vessels sit on the water behind them. On the right, men in light robes and turbans load bundles and what look like curved tusks into a wooden dhow, and a rope-tied bundle lies in the foreground. The dress and boats suggest the 19th-century western Indian Ocean or East African coast. There is no visible text or frame, and the painting runs edge to edge.
